example_sentences_in_bangla: তাঁর লীলাখেলা সাঙ্গ হয়েছে, এখন শান্তিতে বিশ্রাম নিচ্ছেন।
এই বয়সে লীলাখেলা সাঙ্গ হলে পরিবারের জন্য কষ্ট হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His divine play is over; he is now resting in peace.
At this age, when the lila ends, it brings sorrow to the family.
history: This idiom draws from Vaishnava traditions where 'lila' refers to the divine pastimes of deities like Krishna, metaphorically extended to human life ending.
note: The idiom carries a poetic, reverential tone towards death, common in Bengali devotional literature.
